description: AGSC-03-11, AGSC-05-16 and AGSC-05-27 all map an inline Markdown link between two items of the Bundle to an untyped `asc:mentions` edge. Derivation: `alpha`'s body carries two inline links to `beta` and one to a heading of its own page. Two references between one pair of items produce ONE triple — the edge is between items, not between occurrences — the self-reference produces none, and the edge has no computed inverse (AGSC-03-04 lists the inverses and `mentions` is not among them). Only the mentions lines are asserted here: the rest of the serialisation is pinned by graph-0016 to graph-0018 and graph-0026, and this file deliberately does not claim to be a complete N-Quads document. The graph term: every line is a quad whose fourth term is the Bundle IRI `<https://a.example/>` (AGSC-04-15), written as ` <https://a.example/>` before the terminating ` .` of each line; because every line carries the same graph term, the lines are in the byte order of their triples.
